findings.evidence: The same three-step unfolding appears in `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_eq_iff`, `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_add`, `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_smul`, `coe_toHomogeneousBesovSpace_apply_eq` and `exists_toHomogeneousBesovSpace_eq`. BesovSpace.lean:271 provides `theorem ext` for the inhomogeneous analogue.
findings.fix: Add `@[ext] theorem HomogeneousBesovSpace.ext {v w} (h : ∀ j, ((v : lp _ q) j : 𝓢'(E, F)) = ((w : lp _ q) j : 𝓢'(E, F))) : v = w`, matching `BesovSpace.ext`, and use it in those five proofs.
findings.issue: No extensionality lemma for `HomogeneousBesovSpace`. `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_eq_iff`, `_add`, `_smul`, `coe_toHomogeneousBesovSpace_apply_eq` and `exists_toHomogeneousBesovSpace_eq` all unfold `Subtype.ext (lp.ext (funext …))` and then apply `LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.1 Lp.ker_toTemperedDistributionCLM_eq_bot`. Every consumer would have to repeat this.

findings.evidence: In the inhomogeneous file BesovSpace.lean:315-357, every operation lemma (`toDistr_zero/add/neg/sub/smul`) carries `@[simp]`. Here only `coe_toHomogeneousBesovSpace_apply` is tagged.
findings.fix: Add `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_zero`, `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_neg` and `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_sub`, and mark all five lemmas `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: The image map's interaction with the operations in scope is incomplete. `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_zero`, `_neg` and `_sub` are missing, even though `MemHomogeneousBesov.zero/neg/sub` are provided. `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_add` and `toHomogeneousBesovSpace_smul` are normal-form lemmas but are not `@[simp]`.

summary: The predicate and block API are well placed and the block definition stays hidden, but the bundled `HomogeneousBesovSpace` lacks an ext lemma and a complete, simp-annotated API for the image map `toHomogeneousBesovSpace`.
